dz: 被废黜的普世牧首君士坦丁堡·内斯托里乌斯被认为是内斯托里乌斯主义的发源地,被罗马皇帝特奥多修斯二世放逐到埃及的一个修道院.
de: Deposed Ecumenical Patriarch of Constantinople Nestorius, considered the originator of Nestorianism, is exiled by Roman Emperor Theodosius II to a monastery in Egypt.
